subject.title: fix(doctor): bound legacy sessions.json reads during SQLite inspect

question: Should doctor reject all otherwise valid legacy session stores above 16 MiB, or must migration support them through a bounded incremental path?
rationale: The cap prevents resource exhaustion but changes the migration contract for existing user state; the safe maximum and recovery behavior require maintainer intent.

options.title: Implement bounded large-store migration
options.body: Keep the fail-closed protection for malformed or hostile inputs while processing valid large legacy stores without one unbounded allocation.

options.title: Adopt a 16 MiB support ceiling
options.body: Accept the compatibility break only with a documented doctor recovery path and explicit migrate-mode behavior proving state is neither archived nor partially migrated.

recommendation.title: Implement bounded large-store migration
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed protection for malformed or hostile inputs while processing valid large legacy stores without one unbounded allocation.
